title: Germany: LUCID registration and dual-system contract
summary: Packaging subject to system participation must be registered in the LUCID packaging register before it is placed on the German market, and a contract with a dual system must be in place.

sources.title: Zentrale Stelle Verpackungsregister — LUCID
sources.note: Practical/registry-facing source, confirmed live and describing the same registration process as the statute below.

sources.title: Verpackungsgesetz (VerpackG) §§ 7, 9
sources.note: Fetched the official consolidated statute text. § 9(1): 'Hersteller von mit Ware befüllten Verpackungen sind verpflichtet, sich vor dem Inverkehrbringen der Verpackungen bei der Zentralen Stelle registrieren zu lassen' — 'Manufacturers of goods-filled packaging must register with the Zentrale Stelle before placing the packaging on the market,' matching this requirement's summary exactly. § 7 ('Systembeteiligungspflicht') is the separate dual-system participation duty for system-relevant packaging, also matching. Both article numbers already in the draft are correct; PPWR (the EU regulation, in force from 12 Aug 2026 per verpackungsregister.org) is reshaping some responsibilities and is worth a note for the next review cycle but does not change what is cited here today. READY for Tabeen's sign-off.
